content_fields.title: Verify that seccomp profile is enabled (Docker)
content_fields.description: Drop privileged mode so the default seccomp profile applies, and pin the profile explicitly.
content_fields.finding: privileged: true disables the default seccomp profile for the container.
content_fields.required_fix:
# docker-compose.yml
  web:
    privileged: false
    security_opt:
      - seccomp=./deploy/seccomp-restaurant.json
      - no-new-privileges:true
criteria: A seccomp profile is referenced explicitly rather than relying on the default.
